patthana23.3:1.1: Nakusalo naupādinnupādāniyo dhammo abyākatassa upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… cha pañhā.
patthana23.3:2.1: Nakusalaṃ naanupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana23.3:3.1: Nakusalaṃ naanupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
